Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
AROBS is looking for a Senior AWS Cloud Network, Landing Zone & NetOps Engineer to join an exciting project in the FinTech domain !
 Are you passionate about building secure, scalable, and resilient cloud foundations on AWS? We're looking for an experienced engineer who can design and implement robust networking architectures and landing zone solutions for multi-tenant cloud environments.
 Key responsibilities 
Design and implement AWS landing zone services supporting dedicated customer tenants and shared service tenants.
Define cloud network architectures including VPC design, Transit Gateway, routing domains, network segmentation and multi-account connectivity.
Deliver Terraform modules and automation for landing zone and network provisioning.
Design secure connectivity patterns between tenant environments, shared services and external client ecosystems.
Implement network governance, security controls and operational standards.
Establish network monitoring, troubleshooting and NetOps processes for production operations.
Support platform resilience through high-availability, failover and disaster recovery designs.
Produce operational documentation, architecture standards and runbooks for platform and operations teams.
 Required skills 
Strong AWS networking experience (VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53, Load Balancers, PrivateLink, Direct Connect and VPN).
Experience designing and operating AWS landing zones in multi-account environments.
Terraform module authoring and Infrastructure as Code best practices.
Cloud network operations and production support experience.
Experience within SaaS or multi-tenant cloud platforms.
Understanding of Kubernetes and EKS networking concepts.
